title: Room Reservations Room-Type Capacity and Move Differential Schedule
content:
## Room-type capacity schedule

| Room type | Adults it sleeps | Published move differential (USD per night) |
|---|---|---|
| Standard room, one king bed | 2 | 0.00 |
| Deluxe room, one king bed | 2 | 55.00 |
| Standard room, two queen beds | 4 | 40.00 |
| Junior suite | 4 | 120.00 |
| One-bedroom suite | 6 | 210.00 |

## Pricing of a move

When the adults registered on a confirmed Room Reservations reservation are more than its room type sleeps, the reservation is moved to the lowest-priced room type that sleeps them, each room type sleeping the number of adults the room-type capacity schedule gives it and being priced by its published move differential.

The move supplement is the published differential of the new room type less that of the room type it leaves, charged on every night at the plan's share of the Flexible Rate, that is reduced by the plan's discount off the Flexible Rate. A move never lowers the nightly rate: where the new room type's differential is below that of the room type it leaves, no differential is charged.

The new nightly rate is the nightly rate on the reservation plus the move supplement, rounded to the cent. Rounding happens once, on the new nightly rate.

## Room type a move leads to

Reading the schedule for the lowest-priced room type that sleeps the adults registered:

| Adults registered | Room types that sleep them | Lowest-priced of them |
|---|---|---|
| 3 or 4 | Standard room with two queen beds (40.00), junior suite (120.00), one-bedroom suite (210.00) | Standard room, two queen beds |
| 5 or 6 | One-bedroom suite (210.00) | One-bedroom suite |

## Worked moves (hypothetical reservations)

| Reservation | Move | Differential: new less old | Plan's discount off the Flexible Rate | Move supplement | New nightly rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Flexible Rate, standard king at 189.00, 3 adults | to standard two queens | 40.00 less 0.00: 40.00 | 0% | 40.00 | 229.00 |
| Member Flexible Rate, standard two queens at 260.00, 5 adults | to one-bedroom suite | 210.00 less 40.00: 170.00 | 7% | 170.00 less 7%: 158.10 | 418.10 |
| Corporate Negotiated Rate, junior suite at 245.55, 5 adults | to one-bedroom suite | 210.00 less 120.00: 90.00 | 10% | 81.00 | 326.55 |
| Semi-Flexible Saver Rate, deluxe king at 230.00, 3 adults | to standard two queens | 40.00 less 55.00 is below zero: none charged | 8% | 0.00 | 230.00 |

In the last case the room type changes and the nightly rate does not: a move never lowers the nightly rate.
